# [EPIC] Event-Driven Analytics with Kafka

## Epic
Production-grade operability on top of the existing TMDB facade: event-driven analytics (Kafka), distributed tracing (Micrometer Tracing + Zipkin), consumer-driven contract testing (Spring Cloud Contract), and load-tested SLO verification (Gatling).

## Business Value
Showcases observability, contract safety, and verified performance — the practices this repo exists to demonstrate, not a Filmpire end-user feature.

## Product Goal alignment
Serves the "production-grade backend... observability practice" half of the [Product Goal](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md), separate from core-functionality epics.

## References
ADR-006 (Kafka), ADR-007 (tracing/Zipkin), ADR-008 (contract testing); ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2, §12.3, §10.5-10.6, §12.4.

## Status
- 1 of 3 Stories done (#98). #96 and #97 not started — no Kafka, tracing, or contract-test references anywhere in the codebase.
- #96's Tasks (#40, #41) are open, not started, blocked in the current sandbox: only JDK 21 is available (project needs JDK 25, proxy blocks fetching it) and the Docker daemon can't start (nested-container restriction), so Kafka/backend work isn't runnable here.
- #97 has no Tasks broken down yet under it.
